gauntlet: question
The repaired acme/widgets#77 now has one criterion: "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." I re-extracted it, and it stays `in-scope`. It matches the traced path from `settings/resolver.ts:12`, which owns defaults, into `ui/report-view.ts:30`, which consumes the resolved settings. No disposition change is needed, and the kept framing stands.

One behavior is still undecided: what the setting does to active report filters when the user switches workspaces. Today the filters carry over and can hide rows in the new workspace. Which outcome should the setting produce by default?
A) reset by default - switching workspaces clears report filters, and users can opt in to keep them
B) keep by default - current behavior stays the default, and users can opt in to resetting filters on a switch
C) per-workspace memory - each workspace restores its own last filters, so one workspace's filters never apply to another
D) other - name it
Recommendation: A - it fixes the reported hidden-rows problem without the user doing anything. It also needs only a resolver default plus one consumer check in the report view, with no new filter storage.
